channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Ministro diz que Lula vê derrota de Messias como natural numa democracia
item.description: The Minister of Secom, Sidônio Palmeira, stated that President Lula (PT) is tranquil about the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF, calling the outcome natural in a democracy. The comment was made in a column interview, reflecting the government's stance amid the impasse over the Supreme Court appointment.

item.title: Rejeição a Messias no Senado é histórica e não acontecia há 132 anos; saiba mais
item.description: The Senate rejected Jorge Messias's nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, with 34 votes in favor and 42 against. This marks the first time since 1892 that a presidential nominee for the STF has been rejected, making it a historic event in Brazilian politics. The vote reflects strong opposition to Lula's chosen candidate.

item.title: “Governo Lula acabou”, diz Flávio após rejeição de Messias
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) declared that "Lula's government is over" after the Senate rejected the nomination of Jorge Messias to the Supreme Federal Court (STF), voting 42 to 34 against Lula's pick. He posted "Lula's government is over. GREAT DAY" on X (formerly Twitter), celebrating the government's defeat.

item.title: As primeiras percepções do governo Lula após derrota de Messias no Senado
item.description: The defeat of Jorge Messias in the Senate vote for the STF, with 34 votes in favor and 42 against, was seen as a significant political setback at the Planalto Palace, particularly because it was driven by the opposition and the Centrão, suggesting coordinated resistance to Lula’s nomination. The government assesses that revisiting the issue before the October elections is not feasible, with reconsideration possible only if Lula is re-elected, and rules out Rodrigo Pacheco as a backup option, viewing it as a concession to Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, who had favored the Minas Gerais senator for the position.

item.title: Messias recebe telefonema de consolação de Lula
item.description: Union Attorney General Jorge Messias received a consoling phone call from President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva after the Federal Senate rejected his nomination to the Supreme Federal Court. The call was facilitated by Senate government leader Jaques Wagner while Messias was surrounded by allies in the government leadership.

item.title: Mendonça defende Messias e diz que Brasil ‘perde a oportunidade de ter um grande ministro’
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça publicly defended the rejected nomination of Jorge Messias to the STF, stating Brazil misses the opportunity to have a great minister. Mendonça praised Messias’s integrity and constitutional qualifications, urging him to leave the battle with his head held high.

item.title: Jaques Wagner se encontra com Lula após derrota de Messias
item.description: Senate Government Leader Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) met with President Lula after the rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Court, which failed with 42 votes against and 34 in favor — short of the 41 needed for approval. The process has been archived, and Lula must now submit a new nominee for the vacancy left by Luís Roberto Barroso, restarting the CCJ review and full Senate vote.

item.title: TSE vence 4º Prêmio Social Media Gov na categoria melhor trend de 2025
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) won the 4th Social Media Gov Award in the 'Best Meme/Trend of the Year' category for 2025 with the piece 'Urna-Chan loves free, fair and transparent elections', published on TikTok. Created by Júlia Araújo of TSE's Secom, the initiative used humor and casual language to engage youth and demystify electronic voting machines. The award was presented at the 15th National Public Communication Forum in Florianópolis.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro: Derrota não é de Messias, mas do governo Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) attributed the rejection of Jorge Messias’ nomination to the Supreme Federal Court to the Lula government, stating the defeat reflects the president’s attempt to place a third ally on the Court. He noted that the 42 votes against, while insufficient for impeachment, signal a societal message to STF justices regarding judicial overreach. Flávio labeled Lula’s appointees in this term, Cristiano Zanin and Flávio Dino, as militants and views the outcome as a warning to the Court.

item.title: Acessibilidade nos locais de votação e eleições do futuro são tema de evento no TSE
item.description: The TSE held the event 'Electoral Justice for All: Together for Accessibility and Inclusion,' bringing together electoral justice staff from across Brazil to discuss actions for a more inclusive democracy. Key topics included accessibility at polling places and future elections, focusing on overcoming barriers for people with disabilities, particularly in non-adapted venues like public schools.

item.title: “Vitória do povo”, diz líder da oposição sobre rejeição de Messias
item.description: Senator Izalci Lucas (PL-DF), leader of the opposition in Congress, celebrated the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, which was voted down 42 to 34. He described the outcome as a 'victory for the people'.

item.title: Messias diz após derrota no Senado que passou por processo de 'desconstrução' durante campanha por vaga ao STF: 'Sabemos quem comandou'
item.description: Attorney General Jorge Messias was rejected by the Senate in his nomination to the Supreme Federal Court (STF), receiving only 34 votes — seven short of the required majority. He described the process as a 'deconstruction' and blamed political maneuvers, particularly by Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, for orchestrating his defeat. The rejection marks the first time since Brazil's redemocratization that an STF nominee has been blocked by the Senate, delivering a historic blow to President Lula’s administration and heightening tensions with Congress ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Rejeição Messias: indicado por Bolsonaro, ministro André Mendonça diz que 'Brasil perde a oportunidade de ter um grande ministro do Supremo'
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça, appointed by Jair Bolsonaro, lamented the historic rejection of Jorge Messias's nomination to the STF, stating that Brazil loses the opportunity to have a great justice. Mendonça praised Messias's character, integrity, and constitutional qualifications, and offered personal and spiritual support.

item.title: “Brasil perde a oportunidade de ter um grande ministro”, diz Mendonça
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça criticized the Senate's rejection of Attorney General Jorge Messias's nomination to the STF, saying Brazil missed the chance to have a 'great' minister. Mendonça praised Messias's integrity and qualifications, citing a biblical reference to support him following the Senate vote.

item.title: Próximo presidente indicará quatro ministros ao STF
item.description: Following the rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF, the president elected in 2026 will appoint four justices to the Supreme Federal Court. This is due to the vacancy left by Luís Roberto Barroso not being filled by the current administration, increasing the number of appointments for the next president. The report was first published by O Antagonista.

item.title: Alcolumbre articulou derrota de Messias e mandou recado ao STF e a Lula
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre secretly orchestrated the defeat of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, securing only 34 favorable votes against the required 41. The effort involved senators from parties such as Republicans, PSD, União Brasil, and Avante, alongside the pre-existing bloc of PL and Novo. The loss was seen as a message to the STF regarding its alleged 'hypertrophy' and to President Lula for overlooking Alcolumbre’s preferred candidate, Rodrigo Pacheco.

item.title: 'A vida é assim', diz Messias após ter nome rejeitado no Senado
item.description: Attorney General Jorge Messias spoke for the first time after his nomination to the Supreme Federal Court was rejected by the Senate, expressing gratitude for the support received and accepting the outcome as part of the democratic process. He said life includes both victories and defeats, and that this is not the end of his journey. The secret vote resulted in 42 against, 34 in favor, and one abstention — the first presidential Supreme Court nomination rejected since 1894.

item.title: Mendonça lamenta rejeição de Messias para o STF: ‘Brasil perde a oportunidade de ter um grande ministro do Supremo’
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça expressed regret over the Senate's rejection of Attorney General Messias's nomination to the STF, stating that Brazil loses the chance to have a great minister. Mendonça affirmed Messias possesses integrity, strong character, and meets all constitutional requirements for the position, emphasizing their shared evangelical faith and Bolsonaro-era alignment.

item.title: O que está por trás da derrota histórica de Lula e Messias no Senado
item.description: The Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias's nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, by a vote of 42 to 34, marks the first such defeat in 132 years of Brazilian history. The lack of support from Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, combined with betrayals by Centrão senators, proved decisive in the outcome, which even the opposition did not initially anticipate.

item.title: Colunistas avaliam derrota histórica do governo Lula na rejeição de Messias para o STF
item.description: The rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court by the Senate was described by Globo News columnists as the biggest political crisis of Lula's third term, revealing governmental articulation failures and the rise of the Centrão under Davi Alcolumbre's influence. The defeat was seen as a personal blow to Lula, undermining his ability to appoint future justices and fueling a political narrative of confrontation with the Court that could affect the 2026 elections.

item.title: ‘Chantagem política’ e ‘vitória histórica’: as reações à rejeição da indicação de Messias
item.description: The Senate rejected Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court with only 34 votes in favor, falling short of the 41 required — marking the first presidential defeat in a Supreme Court nomination since 1894. Government allies framed the outcome as a 'historic victory' for the opposition and an act of 'political blackmail' driven by bolsonarists, while figures such as Guilherme Boulos, Jandira Feghali, and Sérgio Nobre condemned the decision as damaging to Brazilian democracy and institutional integrity.

item.title: Alcolumbre atropela governo com derrota histórica para Lula e manda recado: "quem manda no Senado sou eu"
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) dealt a historic blow to the Lula government by blocking the nomination of Jorge Messias to the Supreme Court, asserting his institutional control over the legislature. He emphasized that no significant Senate decision occurs without his direct coordination, rejecting behind-the-scenes negotiations. The move was backed by opposition sectors, including Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), in a coordinated effort to weaken the Planalto.

item.title: Randolfe: “Não é agradável ter a rejeição de um candidato ao STF”
item.description: Senator Randolfe Rodrigues (PT-AP), the government leader in Congress, lamented the Senate's rejection of Attorney General Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court (STF), which was voted down 42-34. He said it is unpleasant to see a Supreme Court nominee rejected, especially one appointed by President Lula (PT). The defeat signals political resistance to the government's choice for the high court vacancy.

item.title: Bolsonaristas comemoram derrota histórica de Lula após Senado barrar Messias
item.description: The Senate rejected Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court by a 42-34 vote, marking the first presidential defeat since 1894. Bolsonarists celebrated the outcome as a victory against alleged PT influence over the judiciary, emphasizing Senate independence. Flávio Bolsonaro, Tereza Cristina, Carlos Portinho, Sergio Moro, and Romeu Zema praised the decision, linking it to constitutional defense and criticizing Messias' stances on fetal abortion and the State Enterprises Law.

item.title: Governo e oposição repercutem rejeição de Messias para o STF
item.description: Government and opposition reacted to the rejection of Jorge Rodrigo Araújo Messias' nomination to the STF, with government leader Randolfe Rodrigues stating that Executive-Congress relations will remain unchanged, while opposition leader Rogério Marinho called the outcome a crushing defeat for Lula, damaging his credibility and political negotiating capacity.

item.title: Derrota atinge governabilidade e candidatura de Lula
item.description: The historic defeat of Jorge Messias’ nomination to the Supreme Federal Court constitutes a major blow to Lula’s governability and threatens his 2026 re-election bid. Opposition forces, led by Senate President Davi Alcolumbre and PL leader Rogério Marinho, executed a two-month silent campaign that secured the rejection of the presidential nominee, exposing the government’s weakened congressional base. The episode signals that any Lula nominee lacking Alcolumbre’s approval faces high risk of failure, marking a shift in power dynamics unfavorable to the Planalto.

item.title: VÍDEO: Tapa na mesa, microfone atirado e abraço em líder de Lula; veja reação de Alcolumbre após rejeição de Messias
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre slammed his desk, threw his microphone, and embraced government leader Jaques Wagner after the secret rejection of Jorge Messias' Supreme Court nomination by a 42-34 vote. This marks the first presidential STF nomination rejection since 1894, forcing Lula to submit a new candidate. The government condemned the outcome as a victory of bolsonarism and political blackmail.

item.title: “Hoje acaba o Lula 3”, diz Rogério Marinho sobre rejeição de Messias
item.description: Senate opposition leader Rogério Marinho (PL-RN) celebrated the rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, stating 'today ends Lula 3'. The Senate plenary rejected President Lula's nomination by 42 votes against. Marinho emphasized that the opposition actively worked to achieve this outcome.

item.title: Boulos aponta “aliança entre bolsonarismo e chantagem política” após rejeição de Messias
item.description: The Minister of the General Secretariat of the Presidency, Guilherme Boulos, labeled the rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF as 'political blackmail,' attributing the outcome to an alliance between bolsonarismo and institutional pressure tactics. He said the Senate emerged 'smaller' from the episode, with 42 votes against and 34 in favor of the nomination.

item.title: Os erros de Lula e os maus motivos do Senado
item.description: The Senate defeated President Lula for what are considered bad reasons, anticipating a political conflict that contaminated an institutional decision. The vote was influenced by particular interests of the Senate president, compromising the impartiality of the process.

item.title: Após derrota histórica, Messias conversa com Lula ao telefone
item.description: Jorge Messias, Lula's nominee for the Supreme Federal Court, saw his appointment rejected by the Senate after 132 years, with 34 votes in favor and 42 against — seven short of the required majority. The phone call with President Lula occurred minutes after the defeat, facilitated by government leader Jaques Wagner, in the presence of ministers and allies. The setback deepens tensions between the government and Congress less than six months ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Bastidores: como Lula reagiu à derrota no Senado, segundo ministro
item.description: A minister said Lula reacted calmly to the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Court, stating the president has the right to nominate and the Senate the right to approve or reject. Lula avoided confrontation, seeking to normalize the historic defeat — the first in over 130 years — to prevent framing it as a collapse of his government. The expectation is that he will wait for the dust to settle before deciding on a new nominee, which he can make before the end of his term.

item.title: Bolsonarismo e chantagem política venceram, diz Boulos sobre Messias
item.description: Minister Guilherme Boulos (Psol-SP) criticized the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF, claiming the 'alliance between bolsonarism and political coercion' prevailed. Messias received 42 against and 34 in favor, marking the first Senate rejection of a presidential STF nominee since 1894. Lula must now submit a new name, restarting the full confirmation process.

item.title: “Não tenho nenhuma relação com o diabo”, diz Messias a senado
item.description: President Lula's nominee for the Supreme Court, Jorge Messias, denied having any relation to the devil during a Senate CCJ hearing, responding to a metaphor by Senator Cleitinho comparing election promises to hell and reality to heaven. Although approved in the CCJ with 16 votes in favor and 11 against, Messias was rejected in the full Senate plenary by 42 votes against and 34 in favor, falling short of the 41 required for confirmation.

item.title: O que líder do governo Lula disse após Senado barrar indicação de Messias ao STF
item.description: Lula’s government leader in Congress, Senator Randolfe Rodrigues (PT-AP), downplayed the Senate’s historic rejection of Jorge Messias’ nomination to the Supreme Court, calling it unsurprising and tied to the current electoral climate. He expressed confidence that Lula will be re-elected, stressing that the Senate’s decision does not reflect the will of the Brazilian people, and affirmed that relations between Lula and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre remain institutional and respectful. The government will now assess its next steps, as no alternative nominee has been named.

item.title: Lula perde direito de indicação ao STF após derrota de Messias? Entenda
item.description: The Senate rejected the nomination of Attorney General Jorge Messias to the STF, with 42 votes against and 34 in favor, marking the first presidential nomination rejection to the Supreme Court since 1894. The defeat stemmed from resistance by Senate President Davi Alcolumbre and Bolsonaro-aligned lawmakers, who favored other candidates or preferred to wait for the next administration. Lula retains the right to nominate a new candidate or resubmit Messias, but the choice must undergo a new confirmation process in the CCJ and plenary vote.

item.title: Rejeição a Messias revolta Lula e desespera Planalto, que culpa Alcolumbre
item.description: The Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF caused a major stir at the Planalto, which blames Senate President Davi Alcolumbre and the opposition for the defeat. Lula expressed dissatisfaction, while the government seeks to downplay the political fallout.

item.title: Senado rejeita indicação de Messias para o STF em dura derrota para o governo
item.description: The Senate rejected the nomination of Jorge Messias, Attorney General of the Union, to the Supreme Federal Court, marking a defeat for President Lula's government. The vote took place on Wednesday, April 29, in Brasília. The decision constitutes a significant setback for the Executive's agenda of STF appointments.

item.title: Governo Lula considera relação com Alcolumbre rompida de forma definitiva
item.description: The Lula government considers its relationship with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre to be definitively broken after his defeat in the effort to approve Jorge Messias for the STF. Alcolumbre's decision to block the nomination caused significant institutional strain and was seen as a direct act of opposition to the Executive. This breakdown in trust could negatively affect the government's legislative agenda in 2026.

item.title: Messias rejeitado: quantos votos no Senado receberam os 10 ministros do STF
item.description: The Senate rejected Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, securing only 34 favorable votes against 42 opposed, falling short of the 41 required. This marks the first rejection of a presidential nominee to the STF since 1894. The article also details the vote counts obtained by the ten current STF ministers during their confirmation hearings.

item.title: Rejeição de Messias pelo Senado é criticada pelo governo; vitória é 'aliança entre bolsonarismo e chantagem política', diz Boulos
item.description: Minister Guilherme Boulos criticized the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF, calling it an 'alliance between Bolsonarism and political blackmail'. He said the Senate emerged 'smaller' from the lamentable episode.

item.title: Messias é o primeiro indicado ao STF a ser rejeitado pelo Senado desde 1894
item.description: Jorge Rodrigo Araújo Messias, the Union's Attorney General, was rejected by the Senate in a historic vote with 34 in favor and 42 against, becoming the first STF nominee blocked since 1894. The defeat occurred despite government efforts to secure the required 41 votes, reflecting resistance led by Senate President Davi Alcolumbre and an increasingly polarized climate surrounding Supreme Court nominations.

item.title: Aprovadas em Plenário cinco indicações para o CNJ
item.description: Five nominations for the National Council of Justice (CNJ) were approved in Plenary on Wednesday (29), with mandates for the 2026-2028 biennium. The approved candidates include Ilan Presser (STJ), Andréa Cunha Esmeraldo (STJ), Kátia Magalhães Arruda (TST) and two others not detailed in the provided excerpt. Voting showed strong support, with Ilan Presser receiving 61 favorable votes, Andréa Cunha Esmeraldo 60 and Kátia Magalhães Arruda 62.

item.title: Derrota histórica de Messias: Senado não rejeitava indicação ao STF desde 1894
item.description: The Senate rejected the nomination of Jorge Messias to the STF, marking the first presidential nomination rejection to the Supreme Court since 1894, during the government of Floriano Peixoto. This is the sixth such rejection in Brazilian republican history, all prior ones occurring under Peixoto’s presidency. Despite the setback, Lula retains the right to nominate another candidate or resubmit Messias, contingent on political negotiations in Congress.

item.title: Indicação de Jorge Messias ao STF é rejeitada pelo Senado
item.description: The Senate rejected Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court by a vote of 42 against and 34 in favor, falling short of the 41 votes required for approval. This marks the first rejection of an STF nomination in 132 years, since the government of Floriano Peixoto in 1894. Messias, nominated by Lula to replace Luís Roberto Barroso, had his formal nomination message sent only in April, despite the announcement in November 2025.

item.title: Saiba o que acontece depois de rejeição de Messias no Senado
item.description: The Senate rejected Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, securing only 34 votes against the required 41, marking the biggest political defeat of Lula's third term. The secret vote exposed betrayals within the government's base, despite a R$13 billion investment in budget amendments. Lula must now submit a new nominee, increasing the Senate president's bargaining power.

item.title: VÍDEO mostra comemoração da oposição no Senado após rejeição de Jorge Messias para o STF
item.description: The Federal Senate rejected Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court (STF) in a secret vote of 42 to 34, with one abstention. This marks the first time since 1894 that senators have rejected a presidential nominee to the STF. Opposition senators celebrated the outcome, and President Lula will now need to submit a new candidate for the vacancy left by Luis Roberto Barroso.

item.title: Senado rejeita nome de Messias para o STF, com 42 votos contrários, em derrota histórica de Lula
item.description: The Federal Senate rejected Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, with 42 votes against and 34 in favor, falling short of the 41 required. This marks the first presidential nomination rejection for the STF since 1894, under President Floriano Peixoto. The vote highlighted growing tensions between the Executive and Legislative branches, with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre openly opposing the nomination and favoring Rodrigo Pacheco.

item.title: Messias é rejeitado pelo Senado com 42 votos contra a indicação; relembre outros placares
item.description: The nomination of Jorge Messias to the Supreme Federal Court (STF) was rejected by the Senate with 42 votes against and 34 in favor, falling short of the 41 required for approval. This marks the first defeat of a Lula nominee to the STF, following over five months of delay and intense political maneuvering. The secret vote, held after the hearing, highlighted growing tensions between the government and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Messias é aprovado na CCJ e votação vai ao plenário
item.description: The Senate's Constitution and Justice Committee approved Jorge Messias's nomination to the Supreme Federal Court by a vote of 16 to 11, following an eight-hour hearing. The nomination now proceeds to a floor vote in the full Senate.
